title: Steep
provenance: Reported by Sean-Shmulevich (highball-db#465, 2026-10-12), Apple M2 Pro with 16 GB, macOS 26.3.1, a Highball CLI built from source at gin 0e0eb5d, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r21, D3DMetal with d3d10, d3d10_1 and d3d10core disabled, msync, AVX advertised, 1280x720 capped at 30 fps, rated 5 of 5 after a short session. steep.exe was started directly, so the Steam and Ubisoft sign-in path was not tested. Not verified by the maintainer. The same player then found the DXMT cause and wrote the fix (highball-db#465, 2026-10-14), tested with the patched d3d11.dll on engine r21: 'sample count 8 is not supported, using 4' and gameplay with correct rendering; it ships in DXMT 331c552, engines r28 and r29.
notes: Plays on DXMT, the default mode, from engine r28 (Highball 0.10.20 and later), whose DXMT gives steep.exe the highest sample count the Mac has instead of refusing its 8x texture (Sean Shmulevich's fix, highball-db#465). On older engines and the Wine 11 engines up to r27, DXMT refuses that texture and the game does not start; there D3DMetal works with DirectX 10 turned off (DLL overrides d3d10,d3d10_1,d3d10core=d). DXVK started but drew stretched menus and ran slowly. Long sessions and online play are untested.

knownIssues.symptom: In D3DMetal mode the game stops at start with 'Call to unimplemented function D3D11.DLL.D3D11CoreCreateDevice, aborting'
knownIssues.cause: the game loads DirectX 10, and in D3DMetal mode the 64-bit d3d10core comes from DXMT, which needs a Direct3D 11 function D3DMetal does not export
knownIssues.fix: use DXMT on engine r28 or newer, or on an older engine set the environment's DLL overrides (Full page, Advanced) to d3d10,d3d10_1,d3d10core=d and keep D3DMetal

knownIssues.symptom: DXMT refuses an 8-sample texture and the game does not start
knownIssues.cause: the Mac's GPU offers 1, 2 or 4 samples, not 8
knownIssues.fix: engine r28 or newer on the default line (Highball 0.10.18) gives steep.exe 4 samples instead, no other setting needed. On older engines and the Wine 11 engines up to r27, use D3DMetal with DirectX 10 turned off as above
